name: Kazan Myoga
source:
Kazan is a solitary woman with a one-track mind, dedicated above all else to her family. Growing up in a rustic village blanketed by forest, she naturally learned to cut trees for carpentry and kindling. When industry came to town and her sister fell ill, Kazan's way of life was upended. Her trees were bought up by loggers looking for quick cash, and Koharu was only getting worse. She had no choice but to take any available work, even if it meant lending her strength to criminals.
